name: Replacement engine — M57TU2D30 (long block or complete, low mileage)
recommendedBrand: BMW genuine / reputable low-mileage donor (import salvage)
notes: Confirm engine code suffix and injector/turbo compatibility matches VIN WBAFF01070L319611 build date before purchase.

name: Engine gasket set (full overhaul kit)
notes: Includes head gasket, sump gasket, timing cover seals.

name: Main bearing set (standard, size to be measured)
notes: Only required if replacement engine bottom end is being serviced/inspected.

name: Connecting rod bearing set
notes: Root-cause failure component on the old engine — inspect replacement engine bearings regardless of stated mileage.

name: Timing chain kit (chain, guides, tensioner)
notes: Recommended preventive replacement on high-mileage donor engines.

name: Engine oil (low-ash diesel spec, 5W-30)
notes: Must be LL-04 approved for diesel particulate filter compatibility.

name: Engine mount set (left + right hydraulic)
notes: Inspect old mounts for fluid leaks / collapse before deciding to reuse.

name: Radiator (complete pack)
notes: Diesel radiator pack differs from petrol X5 — confirm part fits xDrive35d.

name: Coolant hose set (upper/lower + heater hoses)
notes: Replace all accessible hoses proactively during an engine-out job.

name: Water pump
notes: Confirm mechanical vs electric pump variant.

name: Intercooler
notes: Inspect for oil residue that could indicate turbo seal wear on the old engine.

name: Turbocharger set (small + large, sequential)
notes: Only needed if donor engine turbos fail inspection or bench test.

name: Vacuum line / hose repair kit
notes: Common failure point causing turbo actuator faults.

name: Fuel injector set (6x, reconditioned or new)
notes: Requires injector coding to ECU after installation — plan diagnostics session.

name: High pressure fuel pump
notes: Only replace if diagnostics indicate low rail pressure.

name: Fuel filter
notes: Replace as standard practice with any fuel system work.

name: Glow plug set (6x)
notes: Replace as a set — mixed old/new causes uneven cold start.

name: Glow plug control module
notes: Only if diagnostics show module fault, not just worn plugs.

name: Battery (AGM, correct capacity for diesel + start/stop)
notes: Battery registration required via coding tool after replacement.

name: Clutch / dual-mass flywheel kit (if manual) or torque converter service (auto)
notes: Most E70 35d are ZF 6HP26 automatic — confirm transmission type before ordering.

name: Transmission fluid + filter (ZF lifetime fill service kit)
notes: Service during engine-out access even though BMW labels it 'lifetime'.

name: Front suspension refresh kit (control arms, bushings, ball joints)
notes: Good opportunity while engine/subframe access is already open.

name: Brake pad + rotor set (front and rear)
Amplifier — aftermarket 4-channel
notes: Entry-upgrade tier. See Sound System Planner.

name: Subwoofer + enclosure
notes: Prioritize sealed under-floor enclosure to preserve cargo space.

name: Interior trim refresh (leather care kit + trim clips)
